subject: Pen test extracts sampling & redaction playbook — GRC portal intake
messages:
From: Eleni Papadopoulos <eleni.p@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenfield Health Security <gsec@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pen test report — CAIQ artifact requirement

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the call earlier. As part of our SIG/CAIQ review we need the penetration test report (or a redacted extract) as an evidence artifact in our GRC portal. Our intake system requires either: (a) the full report with company-sensitive data redacted, or (b) a representative extract package that maps tests to CAIQ and includes sample logs/proof-of-concept screenshots for high/critical findings.

Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide a sampling package (3–5 representative tests including repro steps, screenshots, and mitigation notes) plus a mapping sheet to the CAIQ controls? We have a target upload window next Tuesday.

Pickup questions:
- Would you submit to our GRC portal (link below) or deliver a ZIP to the shared Drive?
- We need a redaction statement (one paragraph) and a timestamped signature from your security lead.

Portal link: https://grc.greenfieldhealth.com/portal/intake/req-87321

Thanks — happy to review scope if you want to call.

Regards,
Eleni Papadopoulos
Security Risk Manager
Greenfield Health

Attachment: intake_checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Eleni Papadopoulos <eleni.p@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report — CAIQ artifact requirement

Eleni — thanks for the clear ask and the portal link. We can absolutely deliver a sampling package instead of the full report. Proposed approach below; please confirm this satisfies Greenfield's intake rules: 

Proposed deliverables (sample package):
- Sample package (ZIP) containing 4 representative test cases: one critical, two high, one medium. Each test case includes: summary, impact, repro steps (redacted), screenshots (POC), mitigation status, and remediation timestamp.
- Mapping spreadsheet (CSV/XLSX) that ties each sample test to CAIQ control IDs and our internal remediation status.
- Redaction statement (one paragraph) and a signed timestamped confirmation from our security lead.
- MD5 checksum and manifest for traceability.

Redaction playbook (high-level):
- Remove customer-specific identifiers (PHI/PPI) and remove full request/response logs that include third-party tokens.
- Replace any verbatim customer data with placeholders such as <REDACTED-CUST-ID>.
- Where screenshots contain PII, crop and blur before export.

Timeline:
- Monday (Jun 14): Redwood provides first draft ZIP + mapping sheet to the shared Drive link you provided.
- Tuesday (Jun 15): You upload into GRC intake; we will standby for any reviewer questions.

I’ve looped in Sean for technical redaction steps, Mina for the final sign-off AND Laura from Legal in case the portal requires an attestation language tweak.

If that works, we’ll attach the sample package and a short readme.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Director — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment plan: redacted_pen_test_v2.pdf (placeholder — we will produce extracts).
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Eleni Papadopoulos <eleni.p@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report — CAIQ artifact requirement

Eleni / team — quick technical clarification and what we'll deliver: 

Clarifications:
- We will NOT include raw packet captures or complete request/response logs; instead we will include short, redacted excerpts that show reproducible steps.
- Proof images will be watermarked "For Audit Use Only" and will have any UI elements containing customer IDs blurred.
- The mapping sheet will include columns: sample_id, finding_severity, finding_summary, mitigation_status, remediation_date, caIQ_control_ids, reference_page_in_report.

Deliverables I'll attach to the Drive by EOD Monday:
- pt-extracts_summary.xlsx (mapping sheet + manifest)
- redacted_pen_test_v2.pdf (four extract pages consolidated)
- readme.txt (redaction rules + contact info)

Next steps for Greenfield:
- Confirm that the mapping columns meet your CAIQ import fields; if you need different column names we can adapt.
- Confirm whether the portal requires the signed attestation to be a PDF with a notarized stamp (we typically provide a signed PDF).

--
Sean Gallagher
Security Operations Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pt-extracts_summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Eleni Papadopoulos <eleni.p@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Greenfield Health Security <gsec@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report — CAIQ artifact requirement

Thanks Sean — that plan looks good. A few quick notes: 

- The portal accepts a ZIP with extracts + a CSV mapping. Column names are flexible; we’ll map on our side.
- Signed PDF attestation is sufficient (no notarization required for this intake). Please include a one-line redaction statement explicitly referencing removal of PHI and third-party tokens.
- Please add the remediation timestamp format as ISO8601 in the mapping sheet (we ingest timestamps).

We expect to ingest Monday evening on our side. Please confirm when the Drive folder contains the ZIP and we’ll do a quick verification.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I’ll circle back if our reviewer flags anything.

Best,
Eleni
